old_problem: Historical review interpreted SYSTEM_CONFIG as a full settings baseline because the item says Config, while the Test Set, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe a sensor record or population. No exact OEM record ID/type or raw-state meaning is given, and a broad CONFIG filter plus DeepSeek's synthetic title query cannot prove the intended population. Criteria jump from 2 to 79.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by reading the complete row context: this is in Test Set `Sensor check`; all three explicit procedures and all criteria require sensor views, so SYSTEM_CONFIG is treated as an opaque OEM configuration-status sensor namespace, not authorization to inventory or change platform settings. ED-03 permits exact records and decoding as Project Configuration, while ED-15 forbids invented states. A broader settings audit would require a separate testcase and cannot be inferred here.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2035, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2036 / Wistron-BMC-01055-V002 / 1f81e75a37340d5a.
Sub Function BMC, Test Set Sensor check, SDR/Sensor-list Procedure, Web Sensor list and sensor-reading Criteria consistently outweigh the ambiguous word Config in Items.
SYSTEM_CONFIG remains an opaque OEM label: no expansion, settings key inventory, record name or state meaning is guessed. Complete inventories precede selection using an approved ID/type/alias map.
The test validates configuration-status telemetry only. It does not prove BIOS/BMC settings compliance and never saves, applies, resets or writes configuration.
Criteria 1, 2 and 79 are retained without inventing 3-78.
No ipmitool, sensor/configuration query, authentication, Web capture, save/apply/reset/write, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-defined SYSTEM_CONFIG configuration-status sensor record has the correct identity, raw/decoded state, description and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, without treating it as a general settings audit or altering configuration.
required_package: SUT/BMC/firmware identity and versioned definition of the opaque SYSTEM_CONFIG sensor namespace
Exact included record IDs/types, CONFIG aliases and component/configuration-status function mapping
Per-record raw-state decoder, accepted/degraded/failed/unknown rules, thresholds only if applicable and freshness/view crosswalk
Preserved BMC/configuration/SEL context, approved ipmitool and protected access
BMC/platform owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; preserve configuration-status and SEL evidence. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before CONFIG filtering, select each approved SYSTEM_CONFIG record by ID/type/alias, and capture every mapped Web Sensor row. Compare raw/decoded state, description and freshness with the signed sensor specification. Do not query the item title unless it is an approved actual record, expand this into a settings inventory, save/apply/reset/write configuration, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved SYSTEM_CONFIG status member appears exactly once with correct function and fresh aligned raw/decoded healthy state in all supported sensor views; no configuration or telemetry fault occurs and no settings-compliance claim is made.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed OEM sensor definition/population and complete supported-view evidence matching approved states. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, wrong record/function, raw/decoded mismatch or degraded/failed/unknown state. Missing record/decoder map is NOT READY; this row cannot PASS a settings audit; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive sensor reads only; no configuration save, apply, reset, write or policy change.
Preserve logs/SEL and protect credentials; capture full inventories before selection.
Stop on unknown record semantics, degraded/failed state, identity mismatch or channel disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve first raw state and context.
expected_evidence: Versioned opaque SYSTEM_CONFIG namespace, member IDs/types/aliases/functions and raw-state decoder
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web Sensor evidence for every approved member
Per-member raw/decoded/description/freshness and missing/extra/duplicate analysis with preserved SEL context
Sensor-not-settings scope, numbering, no-save/apply/reset/write/no-clear/no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, access failure, unknown record type, degraded/failed state or view mismatch, stop and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not modify configuration, clear logs or retry; escalate exact record ID and configuration-status function.

source_conflict.reason: The full row context resolves SYSTEM_CONFIG as an opaque Sensor-check object; an approved OEM record map supplies semantics without inventing settings coverage. The broad CONFIG filter remains discovery-only.
